  • If a forum full of people takes a perfectly solid site for validating legends and debunking online scams, and paints it as pure trash on an always-has-been, because-I-said-so basis, then that forum has all the credibility of a gaggle of movie critics. If the site dies on its own, so be it, but there's no need to push for it to happen.
  • It is silly when people call for the credentials of the people associated with Snopes. To run a fact-checking site, all you really need is a sense of rationality, objectivity, and critical thinking; and the ability to reference where your facts are coming from. What's more, we don't want to tear down fact-checking sites when the problem is an emergent bias and/or sellout. We'd want to call out and fix the sources of bias and pressure to sell out. In principle, getting rid of fact-checking makes it easy to hand rulership over to idiots, con-artists, and agitators.
